title: Degraded session-log persistence isolation
body: The MCP REPL SHALL isolate plugins from MCP Session Log service degradation during session and in-progress turn operations. When a turn closes while the primary service is degraded, the REPL SHALL durably persist the complete turn through an independent failsafe strategy and SHALL notify the caller with the failsafe path.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Open, begin, update, appendDialog, and appendActions remain successful when primary MCP Session Log persistence fails but failsafe persistence succeeds.
The failsafe artifact contains a replayable session-log persistence envelope including the attempted turn data and status.
completeTurn and failTurn report degraded persistence, the independent strategy name, and the absolute failsafe path without claiming primary MCP persistence succeeded.
Primary persistence success produces no pending failsafe artifact and reports normal MCP persistence.
